jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.
There is an open Part Time Athletic Director position at the Lunenburg High School.

TITLE:  Athletic Director (.5 Position)
LOCATON:  Lunenburg High School, 1075 Massachusetts Avenue, Lunenburg, MA  01462
FUNDING SOURCE:  Local funds 
REPORTS TO:  Superintendent of Schools and, when necessary, the Building Principal

JOB SUMMARY
The primary function is to provide leadership in the development, organization, implementation, coordination, and evaluation of the athletic programs.  The Athletic Director works collaboratively to lead members of the staff and communicate effectively with students, parents, members of the community, and colleagues within the Lunenburg School District as well as other districts. Inherent in the position are responsibilities for planning, curriculum development, program evaluation, and personnel and financial management.  The position is also responsible for assisting the Lunenburg Middle-High School administration in conducting student investigations in the areas of behavior, harassment or bullying.  Requires keeping current on relevant policy, procedure, law, and student handbook rules and effective communication with students, parents/guardians.

Requirements:   Minimum of Master’s degree with administrative, teaching and coaching experience. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
Prepare and manage a master budget for all athletic programs
Supervise and maintain equipment inventories
Prepare a master sports calendar that includes conference and non-conference games/events
Coordinate gyms, building and athletic field use with district/city facilities and maintain the district building use calendar for athletic events
Coordinate and manage athletic field and facility requests by outside organizations coordinating with the High School Administration and the District Office  
Coordinate gym and field use for practices and games and give final clearance for use of either the gym or the athletic field
Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of curriculum development and program evaluation, child growth and development, and effective instructional strategies
Hire coaching staff, coordinating required payroll work and background checks with District Office
Monitor and evaluate all head coaches and hold head coaches accountable for evaluating assistant coaches.  Evaluations should be shared with High School Administration following each athletic season
Work with coaching staff and transportation contractor to schedule all athletic departure times and provide bus supervision with appropriate paperwork
Seek and recommend suitable competition for all non-conference events/games
Manage official’s and all non-conference contest payments
Secure game workers for athletic contests  
Coordinate collection of rosters for program information as needed
Submit athletic expense request for payment of coaches, officials, and other workers to payroll with appropriate paperwork
Assist in supervision of at home athletic contests
Evaluate all athletic programs on an annual basis, making recommendations for improvement to the Building Principal and Superintendent when necessary
Meet with, orient, and provide in-service training for all coaches within 3 weeks prior to the sports season and hold an evaluation conference with all coaches within 3 weeks after the conclusion of their sport season
Coordinate review of student athlete grades by using coaches and guidance councilors
Manage the resolution of problems, issues, and concerns that may arise between coaches and athletic programs
Provide a channel through which students and the community may express their concerns about an athletic program or coach
Distribute and Massachusetts High School Activities Association (MIAA) materials and enforce MIAA rules and regulations, including player eligibility
Collect, file, and notify athletes and coaches regarding student eligibility as it pertains to MIAA requirements and athletic codes of conduct
Collect and maintain on file, properly completed and current physical exam card for every student participating in athletics
Distribute and maintain on file athletic training rules and codes of conduct signed by students participating in athletics
Administer the school athletic code in a fair and consistent manner within the intent of the code and the missions of the school and the Lunenburg School District
Ensure District adherence to all MIAA and district policies, administrative rules, procedures and codes relating to participation in athletics
Coordinate ordering of uniforms, letters, and other awards
Coordinate post season awards ceremonies
Attend athletic conference meetings
Perform other duties which may be assigned to this position by administrators
Coordinate and attend Lunenburg Athletic Advisory Council meetings
Assist the Lunenburg Middle-High School Administration complaint resolution, investigations, student supervision and other duties relative to student athletes as assigned.
Coordinate and schedule youth sports and adult wellness/sports activities who utilize school facilities.


GENERAL EXPECTATIONS:
Manage oneself (be organized, prepared, and punctual; manage resources; meet deadlines; follow through on commitments; demonstrate appropriate physical appearance relative to job and environmental expectations) in a manner that enhances the school community;
Act in ways that directly support the missions of Lunenburg Public Schools on a consistent basis;
Learn and grow as a professional; including attending state conferences/meetings
Because of the safety requirements within this position, the athletic director must speak and write clearly in English;
Demonstrate clear verbal and written communication and active listening skills;
Develop and maintain rapport and effective relationships with adolescents and adults contacted in carrying out duties and responsibilities by using courtesy, diplomacy, collaboration, cooperation and professional conduct;
Demonstrate the ability to use computers for word processing, data management, information retrieval, video and audio presentations, and communications
Contribute to the goals and success of all teams and team members through collaboration, cooperation, and flexibility in team discussions, activities, and decision-making;
Maintain high ethical standards, legal responsibility, and confidentiality.

SUPERVISION
All Coaching Staff and Athletic Trainer

WORKING ENVIRONMENT
The usual and customary methods of performing the job’s functions require the following physical demands: some lifting, carrying, pushing and/or pulling, some stooping, kneeling, sitting, standing, walking, and running. The job is performed in a generally clean and comfortable environment.
